note: Fixed before any Gate 2 run. L2 adds a not-read book, toggles its read status once, and records the status text before and after. Both reference apps should pass. There is no L2-defective corpus app yet, so this gate has no negative control; that needs a separate corpus session (AGENTS.md: corpus apps are built outside Optimus sessions).

A.rationale: The status shows 'Not read' and becomes 'Read' after Toggle read; both texts are in the pack's allowed lists.

B.rationale: The status shows 'To read' and becomes 'Finished' when it is clicked; both texts are in the pack's allowed lists.
